description: Source code for the Com module in an AUTOSAR platform, implementing initialization, data copying, and group management functions for communication PDUs.

methods.name: Com_Init
methods.description: Initializes the COM module with provided configuration, sets endianness, and initializes PDUs and signals.

methods.name: Com_IpduGroupStart
methods.description: Starts a specified IPDU group, marking PDUs as started.

methods.name: Com_IpduGroupStop
methods.description: Stops a specified IPDU group, marking PDUs as stopped.

methods.name: Com_CopyTxData
methods.description: Copies data from internal buffer to PDU for transmission.

methods.name: Com_CopyRxData
methods.description: Copies received PDU data into internal buffer.

methods.name: Com_StartOfReception
methods.description: Prepares reception buffer for incoming PDU, sets dynamic signal length.
